title: Priming Base Models for Agentic Post-Training: An Open Midtraining Recipe
title_zh: 为智能体后训练预训练基础模型：一种开放的中期训练方案

paragraphs.en: Frontier models, general-purpose and domain-specific alike, now include a midtraining stage between pretraining and post-training, but little has been published about how this stage is built. We present an open midtraining recipe that primes base models for agentic post-training, and we show its effectiveness on two Nemotron models of different sizes. Pretraining typically runs at short context and sees almost no agent interactions, while SFT data is mostly synthetic, and very long SFT stages can hurt the model’s later RL trainability. Our midtraining stage sits between the two. It trains at 256K context for hundreds of billions of tokens on a diverse mixture of natural software-engineering data like packed repositories, pull requests, commit histories, and build logs together with a small share of agentic traces. On Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, 500B midtraining tokens improve SWE-bench Verified from 60.7 to 64.5, SWE-bench Multilingual from 55.8 to 62.8, and SWE-bench Pro from 32.0 to 35.5 after identical full SFT. On the larger Nemotron 3.5 Super, 280B midtraining tokens improve DeepSWE, a harder benchmark of long-horizon tasks, from 11.7 to 15.7 and SWE-bench Verified from 72.9 to 74.3 after identical full SFT. Midtraining also improves robustness across agent harnesses on both models. We report the ablations behind the recipe and an evaluation protocol built on short fixed SFT runs, since base-model proxy metrics did not correlate reliably with post-training results.

paragraphs.en: Between pretraining and post-training, frontier coding models such as Qwen3-Coder-Next ( Cao et al., 2026 ) , GLM-5 ( GLM-5 Team, 2026 ) , Kimi-Dev ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and Composer 2 ( Cursor Research, 2026 ) include a midtraining stage of hundreds of billions of tokens of agentic, long-context data on top of a converged base model. Technical reports describe this stage at a high level, but rarely explain how its data is constructed, filtered, and weighted, or measure the impact of each design choice. Following Qwen-Coder ( Hui et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) , we present an open midtraining recipe for agentic coding, developed and demonstrated on Nemotron base models. We describe how each data source is built, and we report the ablations that guided our training choices.

paragraphs.en: Base models are usually pretrained at short sequence lengths, typically 4K to 8K tokens for compute efficiency ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Qwen Team, 2025 ) , and then extended to long context in a short final stage before SFT. Nemotron models, for example, are pretrained at 8K and extended to 1M. The data that matters most for software-engineering agents does not fit this pipeline. Pretraining corpora usually contain almost no agent interactions, as in the Nemotron pretraining corpus ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) , and the natural data around software engineering, such as whole repositories, code evolution through commit histories, pull requests, and build logs, often runs to tens or hundreds of thousands of tokens, too long for pretraining and too large for a short long-context stage. Adding agent traces to pretraining is also not straightforward, since pretraining typically applies no loss masking, and it is unclear how the tool responses (environment outputs) in those traces should be handled. SFT in turn consists mostly of synthetic chat data. Recent work has documented that very long SFT stages can reduce how much the model later gains from RL ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and we have observed this in our own training as well.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型通常在较短的序列长度上进行预训练，出于计算效率的考虑，这一长度通常为 4K 到 8K 个词元（DeepSeek-AI，2024；Qwen Team，2025），然后在 SFT 之前的最后阶段将其扩展到长上下文。 例如，Nemotron 模型在 8K 的序列长度上进行预训练，并随后扩展至 1M。 对软件工程智能体而言，最重要的数据并不符合这一流程。 预训练语料库中几乎不包含智能体交互内容，例如 Nemotron 预训练语料库（NVIDIA，2025）便是如此；此外，与软件工程相关的自然数据，如完整代码仓库、通过提交历史呈现的代码演化过程、拉取请求和构建日志等，通常包含数万甚至数十万个词元，既过长而无法用于预训练，又因规模过大而无法在较短的长上下文阶段中处理。 将智能体轨迹添加到预训练过程中也并非易事，因为预训练通常不会应用损失掩码，而且尚不清楚这些轨迹中的工具响应（环境输出）应如何处理。 而 SFT 本身则主要由合成的对话数据构成。 近期的研究指出，过长的 SFT 阶段可能会降低模型后续通过强化学习获得的提升幅度（Liu et al., 2026b；Kang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026），我们在自己的训练过程中也观察到了这一现象。

paragraphs.en: Midtraining fills this gap. Before the final long-context stage, it trains for hundreds of billions of tokens at 256K, long enough to hold whole repositories, commit histories, and long agent traces (§ 5.1 ). The data is mostly natural software-engineering data, with a bounded share of agent traces whose tool responses are masked from the loss. Much of this learning can therefore move out of SFT, so SFT can stay short and preserve the model’s later RL trainability ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: We develop the recipe on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning-30B-A3B and then scale it to the larger Nemotron 3.5 Super-120B-A12B ( NVIDIA, 2026a ) . paragraphs.en: A fully documented midtraining data recipe, showing that a small share of agentic traces adds clear gains on top of natural data (§ 3 and § 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一份完整记录的中训练数据配方表明，少量智能体轨迹的加入可在自然数据基础上带来显著提升（§ 3 和 § 4.2）。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation protocol based on identical SFT runs, since base-model proxy metrics such as bits-per-byte and LoCoDiff did not reliably predict post-training results (§ 4.1 ).

paragraphs.en: We show that gains hold as we scale both model size and midtraining tokens up to 500B, across benchmarks and agent harnesses (§ 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Although midtraining is growing in popularity, only a few works have presented detailed recipes and ablation results to the community. Qwen3-Coder-Next provides one such recipe, midtraining at a 256K context on trillions of tokens, including 600B tokens of repository-level data across 370 programming languages ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . Its recipe suggests combining mined PR data with agentic traces but does not explain exactly how to do so. GLM-5 reports midtraining on approximately 1.55T tokens with progressive context extension, including 160B tokens of software-engineering data constructed from roughly 10M issue–PR pairs ( GLM-5 Team, 2026 ) , but does not provide details of the recipe. Kimi-Dev, one of the primary works on which we build, provides a more detailed recipe ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . It performs midtraining on approximately 150B tokens of diff patches, commit sequences, and synthetic agent interactions, and shows that a model with this prior needs far fewer SFT tokens than the raw base model to reach the same agent performance. daVinci-Dev advocates trajectory-style midtraining data and matches Kimi-Dev’s performance using fewer than half as many tokens ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . Composer 2 shows that code-focused continued pretraining improves downstream RLVR performance ( Cursor Research, 2026 ) . AgentFounder similarly shows that continued pretraining benefits search agents ( Su et al., 2026 ) , while Liu et al. (2026a) study when midtraining effectively bridges the distributions of pretraining and post-training data. Relative to these works, we provide the ablation-level detail missing from the technical reports and evidence that the gains persist through full SFT.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管中期训练越来越流行，但只有少数研究向社区提供了详细的配方和消融结果。 Qwen3-Coder-Next 提供了其中一种配方：在 256K 上下文长度下，基于数万亿个词元进行中期训练，其中包括来自 370 种编程语言、总量为 6000 亿个词元的项目级数据（Cao et al., 2026）。 其配方建议将挖掘出的 PR 数据与智能体轨迹相结合，但并未具体说明如何操作。 GLM-5 报告称，其中期训练基于约 1.55T 个词元，并逐步扩展上下文长度，其中包括从约 1000 万个问题–PR 对中构建的 1600 亿个词元的软件工程数据（GLM-5 Team, 2026），但并未提供配方的具体细节。 Kimi-Dev 是我们研究的主要基础之一，它提供了更详细的配方（Yang et al., 2026）。 它在约 1500 亿个词元的差异补丁、提交序列和合成智能体交互数据上执行中期训练，并表明具有这种预训练模型所需的 SFT 词元数量远低于原始基础模型，却能达到相同的智能体性能。daVinci-Dev 倡导轨迹风格的期中训练数据，并使用不到一半的词元就达到了与 Kimi-Dev 相当的性能（Zeng et al., 2026）。 Composer 2 表明，专注于代码的持续预训练能够提升下游 RLVR 性能（Cursor Research, 2026）。 AgentFounder 同样表明，持续预训练对搜索智能体有益（Su et al., 2026），而 Liu et al. （2026a）研究了中期训练在何种情况下能有效弥合预训练数据与后训练数据之间的分布差异。 相较于这些研究，我们提供了技术报告中缺失的消融级细节，并证明了这些性能提升在整个 SFT 阶段依然有效。

paragraphs.en: StarCoder2 concatenates repository files in random order ( Lozhkov et al., 2024 ) ; DeepSeek-Coder orders files by import dependencies ( Guo et al., 2024 ) ; SPLiCe shows that structured packing improves long-context use ( Staniszewski et al., 2025 ) ; ProLong randomizes on purpose to avoid recency bias ( Gao et al., 2025 ) . Sapronov & Glukhov (2025) find that most of the gain from repository-level pretraining for project-level code completion comes from adapting to a longer context rather than from how the repository context is assembled. Best-Fit Packing reduces truncation harms ( Ding et al., 2024 ) , and In-Context Pretraining shows related-document packing helps beyond code ( Shi et al., 2024 ) . Our repository data differs in selection . We keep only repositories whose files reference each other through imports, and order files so that related code is adjacent (§ 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: StarCoder2 以随机顺序拼接仓库文件（Lozhkov 等，2024）；DeepSeek-Coder 按导入依赖关系排序文件（Guo 等，2024）；SPLiCe 表明结构化打包能提升长上下文的使用效果（Staniszewski 等，2025）；ProLong 有意采用随机化以避免近期偏见（Gao 等，2025）。 Sapronov 与 Glukhov（2025）发现，仓库级预训练在项目级代码补全中带来的大部分增益，源于对更长上下文的适应，而非仓库上下文的具体组装方式。 Best-Fit Packing 能减少截断带来的负面影响（Ding 等，2024），而 In-Context Pretraining 表明相关文档的打包方式在代码之外的领域也有帮助（Shi 等，2024）。 我们的仓库数据在选取方式上有所不同。 我们仅保留其文件通过导入相互引用的仓库，并按需将相关文件置于相邻位置（§ 3）。

paragraphs.en: Agentic benchmarks are unreliable before post-training, so Composer 2 selects among base models using held-out codebase perplexity, state tracking, and adversarially built QA instead ( Cursor Research, 2026 ) . Other benchmarks target specific skills. LoCoDiff measures file-state reconstruction from git history ( Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ) , RepoBench and CrossCodeEval measure cross-file completion ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2023 ) , and APTBench converts agent tasks into a format base models can answer ( Qin et al., 2025 ) . Whether such base-model measures predict downstream ability is still contested ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . In our experiments, they did not track post-training results reliably (§ 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在训练后阶段之前，智能体基准测试并不可靠，因此 Composer 2 使用预留代码库的困惑度、状态跟踪以及对抗性构建的问答任务来选择基础模型（Cursor Research, 2026）。 其他基准测试则针对特定技能。 LoCoDiff 通过 git 历史记录测量文件状态的重建能力（Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI），RepoBench 和 CrossCodeEval 测量跨文件补全能力（Liu et al., 2024; Ding et al., 2023），而 APTBench 则将智能体任务转换为基础模型能够回答的格式（Qin et al., 2025）。 这类针对基础模型的指标能否预测下游能力仍存在争议（Liu et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2025）。 在我们的实验中，这些指标未能可靠地追踪训练后的结果（§ 4.1）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 summarizes the blend, which is designed for diversity. Most of it is natural software-engineering data, with a small share of synthetic agent traces. We render these traces in the Nemotron chat template and keep them to 10–15% of the blend to avoid overfitting to SFT-like data, which can hurt later RL trainability ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Everything else stays in natural formats, without chat templates. Every source keeps only permissive licenses and goes through decontamination against SWE-bench and Terminal-Bench, secret redaction, and loss masking of content the model should not imitate, such as repeated delimiters, hashes, and timestamps.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 总结了这种混合数据，其设计旨在实现多样性。 其中大部分是自然软件工程数据，仅包含少量合成的智能体轨迹。 我们将这些轨迹以 Nemotron 聊天模板的形式呈现，并将其在混合数据中的比例控制在 10%–15%，以避免对类 SFT 数据过度拟合，因为这可能会损害后续强化学习的训练能力（Liu et al., 2026b；Kang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026）。 其余所有内容均保持自然格式，不使用聊天模板。 每个数据源仅保留宽松许可协议，并经过净化处理，以去除 SWE-bench 和 Terminal-Bench 中的内容、秘密信息，以及对模型不应模仿的内容（如重复的边界符、哈希值和时间戳）进行内容丢失掩码。

paragraphs.en: We construct a large-scale code-change corpus from merged pull requests in public GitHub repositories, combining repository snapshots with PR descriptions, linked issues, review discussions, and observed patch evolution when available. We restrict collection to repositories with at least ten stars in supported programming languages. We deduplicate examples by repository and PR identifier and remove records with unavailable repositories, missing Git objects, failed patch reconstruction, empty or excessively large changes, generated content, or other low-quality patches. Each example is laid out as a sequence in which repository metadata, date, file tree, and code context condition the model’s reconstruction of the submitted changes. No chat template is applied to this data, but we mask repetitive formatting text from the training loss. In total, this process leaves us with 12.1 million PRs and 200 billion to 2 trillion tokens depending on how much repository context we include in each example. For issue-linked PRs, a structured LLM judge additionally checks that the issue and the patch match, and PR-only examples are filtered with deterministic rules (Appendix A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从公共 GitHub 仓库中合并的拉取请求构建了一个大规模代码变更语料库，将仓库快照与拉取请求描述、关联的问题、评审讨论以及可获取的补丁演化过程相结合。 我们将收集范围限制在支持的语言中拥有至少十颗星的仓库。 我们按仓库和拉取请求标识符对示例进行去重，并移除仓库不可用、Git 对象缺失、补丁重建失败、变更内容为空或过大、包含生成内容或其他低质量补丁的记录。 每个示例都以一个序列的形式呈现，其中仓库元数据、日期、文件树和代码上下文共同影响模型对提交变更的重建过程。 这些数据未应用任何聊天模板，但我们会从训练损失中屏蔽重复的格式化文本。 总体而言，这一流程最终为我们留下了 1210 万个拉取请求，以及根据每个示例中是否包含仓库上下文而定的 2000 亿到 2 万亿个词元。 对于关联了问题的拉取请求，一个结构化的 LLM 评判器还会额外检查问题与补丁是否匹配；而仅包含拉取请求的示例则通过确定性规则进行过滤（附录 A.1）。

paragraphs.en: Pretraining corpora have historically presented code as individual files rather than whole repositories, and even when files from one repository are packed together, a short pretraining context holds only a small part of it. Agents, however, work inside repositories far longer than that and must use code defined far from where it is called. Midtraining is where the model first reads whole repositories and predicts code that depends on files tens of thousands of tokens earlier. This helps most when the files actually depend on each other, and in many repositories they do not, since many are collections of scripts, exercises, or snippets that never import one another. We start from the repositories in the Nemotron 3 pretraining corpus ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) , build an import graph for every repository in 14 languages, and keep only repositories in which at least 20% of code files have an import edge to another file in the repository (10% for Ruby). Kept repositories are serialized with the top-level README first and connected files next to each other, and packed at 256K, with longer repositories split between connected components rather than truncated, giving about 104B tokens. Compared to alphabetical ordering, dependency ordering better separates stronger from weaker models. It lowers bits-per-byte for stronger models and raises it for weaker ones, which suggests that it exposes cross-file structure that weaker models have not yet learned. The languages, filters, and blend weights are listed in Appendix A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 历史上，预训练语料库将代码以单个文件的形式呈现，而非整个仓库；即使来自同一仓库的文件被打包在一起，较短的预训练上下文也仅包含其中的一小部分。 然而，智能体在仓库内部的工作时间远长于此，并且必须使用定义位置远离调用位置的代码。 在中训练阶段，模型首次能够读取整个仓库，并预测依赖于数万词元之前文件的代码。 当文件之间确实存在依赖关系时，这种方法效果最佳；但在许多仓库中，文件之间并无这种依赖，因为其中很多只是脚本、练习或代码片段的集合，彼此从未导入。 我们从 Nemotron 3 预训练语料库中的仓库（NVIDIA, 2025）出发，为每种语言的 14 个仓库构建导入图，并仅保留那些至少有 20% 的代码文件对仓库内其他文件存在导入边关系的仓库（Ruby 为 10%）。 被保留的仓库首先按顶层 README 序列化，随后将关联文件依次排列，并以 256K 为单位打包；对于较长的仓库，则将其拆分为多个关联组件，而非截断处理，最终得到约 104B 词元。 与按字母顺序排序相比，依赖顺序排序能更有效地区分强模型与弱模型。 这种方法降低了强模型的每字节比特数，而提高了弱模型的该指标，这表明它揭示了弱模型尚未掌握的跨文件结构。 相关语言、筛选条件及混合权重列于附录 A.2 中。

sents.en: Pretraining corpora have historically presented code as individual files rather than whole repositories, and even when files from one repository are packed together, a short pretraining context holds only a small part of it.
sents.zh: 历史上，预训练语料库将代码以单个文件的形式呈现，而非整个仓库；即使来自同一仓库的文件被打包在一起，较短的预训练上下文也仅包含其中的一小部分。

sents.en: Agents, however, work inside repositories far longer than that and must use code defined far from where it is called.
sents.zh: 然而，智能体在仓库内部的工作时间远长于此，并且必须使用定义位置远离调用位置的代码。

sents.en: Midtraining is where the model first reads whole repositories and predicts code that depends on files tens of thousands of tokens earlier.
sents.zh: 在中训练阶段，模型首次能够读取整个仓库，并预测依赖于数万词元之前文件的代码。

sents.en: This helps most when the files actually depend on each other, and in many repositories they do not, since many are collections of scripts, exercises, or snippets that never import one another.
sents.zh: 当文件之间确实存在依赖关系时，这种方法效果最佳；但在许多仓库中，文件之间并无这种依赖，因为其中很多只是脚本、练习或代码片段的集合，彼此从未导入。

sents.en: We start from the repositories in the Nemotron 3 pretraining corpus ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) , build an import graph for every repository in 14 languages, and keep only repositories in which at least 20% of code files have an import edge to another file in the repository (10% for Ruby).
sents.zh: 我们从 Nemotron 3 预训练语料库中的仓库（NVIDIA, 2025）出发，为每种语言的 14 个仓库构建导入图，并仅保留那些至少有 20% 的代码文件对仓库内其他文件存在导入边关系的仓库（Ruby 为 10%）。

sents.en: Kept repositories are serialized with the top-level README first and connected files next to each other, and packed at 256K, with longer repositories split between connected components rather than truncated, giving about 104B tokens.
sents.zh: 被保留的仓库首先按顶层 README 序列化，随后将关联文件依次排列，并以 256K 为单位打包；对于较长的仓库，则将其拆分为多个关联组件，而非截断处理，最终得到约 104B 词元。

sents.en: Compared to alphabetical ordering, dependency ordering better separates stronger from weaker models.
sents.zh: 与按字母顺序排序相比，依赖顺序排序能更有效地区分强模型与弱模型。

sents.en: It lowers bits-per-byte for stronger models and raises it for weaker ones, which suggests that it exposes cross-file structure that weaker models have not yet learned.
sents.zh: 这种方法降低了强模型的每字节比特数，而提高了弱模型的该指标，这表明它揭示了弱模型尚未掌握的跨文件结构。

paragraphs.en: Much of software engineering is changing existing code, such as making an edit that stays consistent across several files or keeping track of what a file looks like after a long series of changes. Repository snapshots only show code in its final state, so we build two kinds of examples from commit histories. Multi-file edits take a merged pull request, show the model the affected files before the change, and train it to produce them after the change. We keep only changes whose files are linked in the import graph used for the repository data, so that the edits are coupled. Code-evolution documents give the initial state of a file, the sequence of real commits that changed it from oldest to newest, and its final state. This trains the long-range state tracking that LoCoDiff measures ( Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ) . Histories range from a single commit to several dozen. Diff headers, commit hashes, authors, and dates are masked from the loss. Sources, filters, and statistics are in Appendix A.3 .

paragraphs.en: Agents constantly read logs, stack traces, and build output, but PR data lacks the environment’s response, so we add raw system logs from the full LogHub archives ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) and CI/CD logs from GitHub Actions run logs and workflow-file histories ( Moriconi et al., 2025 ; Cardoen et al., 2024 ) , plus a small curated slice pairing log windows with diagnoses (Appendix A.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体持续读取日志、堆栈跟踪和构建输出，但 PR 数据缺少环境的响应，因此我们加入了来自完整 LogHub 存档的原始系统日志（Zhu et al., 2023），以及来自 GitHub Actions 运行日志和工作流文件历史的 CI/CD 日志（Moriconi et al., 2025；Cardoen et al., 2024），此外还加入了一小部分经过筛选的数据，将日志窗口与诊断结果进行配对（附录 A.4）。

paragraphs.en: We include agent trajectories to teach interaction patterns that natural software artifacts lack, such as multi-step tool use, testing changes, and recovering from failures. These trajectories are separate from the SFT data. The highest-quality trajectories are reserved for SFT, and midtraining puts the rest to use, including trajectories from earlier teacher models and tasks that do not fit post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们加入智能体轨迹，以传授自然软件产物所缺乏的交互模式，例如多步骤工具使用、测试变更以及从故障中恢复。 这些轨迹与 SFT 数据是独立的。 质量最高的轨迹保留用于 SFT，而中期训练则利用其余轨迹，包括早期教师模型产生的轨迹以及不适合在训练后使用的任务轨迹。

sents.zh: 我们加入智能体轨迹，以传授自然软件产物所缺乏的交互模式，例如多步骤工具使用、测试变更以及从故障中恢复。

paragraphs.en: The corpus used in our blend contains about 39B tokens (over one million trajectories, about 500K distinct queries, and 30M tool calls, including SWE-Zero and SWE-Hero trajectories ( Ludwig et al., 2026 ) ). A small portion of the agentic midtraining blend consists of data contributed by Perplexity as a partner in the Nemotron Coalition. The full trace corpus covers more than ten agent scaffolds, including OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , OpenCode, SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , Codex, Claude Code, and Terminus, across software engineering, terminal use, search, and general tool use, because traces from a single scaffold transfer poorly to others ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . Each trajectory keeps its scaffold’s instructions and tool definitions and is rendered in the Nemotron chat template. Appendix A.5 gives the statistics and distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们混合语料库中使用的数据包含约 390 亿个词元（超过一百万条轨迹、约 50 万个不同查询和 3000 万次工具调用，包括 SWE-Zero 和 SWE-Hero 的轨迹（Ludwig 等，2026））。 智能体中期训练混合语料库的一小部分由 Perplexity 作为 Nemotron 联盟的合作伙伴所提供的数据组成。 完整的轨迹语料库涵盖了超过十种智能体框架，包括 OpenHands（Wang 等，2025）、OpenCode、SWE-agent（Yang 等，2024）、Codex、Claude Code 和 Terminus，涉及软件工程、终端使用、搜索和通用工具使用，因为来自单一框架的轨迹难以有效迁移到其他框架（Cao 等，2026）。 每条轨迹都保留其框架的指令和工具定义，并以 Nemotron 聊天模板的形式呈现。 附录 A.5 提供了相关统计数据和分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Filtering targets shortcuts and undesirable interaction patterns, including solution leakage through Git history or Internet lookup, unfinished trajectories, malformed tool calls, and repetitive file-inspection loops. As in SFT, we train only on assistant turns, including tool calls, since also training on tool responses hurts results after SFT (§ 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 过滤目标捷径和不当的交互模式，包括通过 Git 历史记录或网络搜索导致的解决方案泄露、未完成的轨迹、格式错误的工具调用以及重复的文件检查循环。 与 SFT 一样，我们仅对助手回合进行训练，其中包含工具调用，因为对工具响应也进行训练会在 SFT 之后损害结果（§ 5.2）。

paragraphs.en: Midtraining starts from a converged base model, so we choose the training setup to add new capabilities without degrading what the base model already knows. We train at 256K context, long enough to hold almost every midtraining document, many of which are far longer than the 8K pretraining context (Figure 2 ). Our first N-3.5 Lightning experiments start from the 8K pretraining checkpoint, N-3.5 Lightning-8K. For the N-3.5 Lightning scaling run and all N-3.5 Super runs, we start from the 1M long-context checkpoint, which lets us go straight from midtraining to SFT, keeping evaluations simple. In a mature pipeline, midtraining would come before the final long-context stage (§ 5.1 ). We set the replay share to 20% (§ 5.3 ). The learning rate warms up briefly and then stays constant, at 5e-5 for N-3.5 Lightning, which favors agentic gains, and 1e-5 for the larger N-3.5 Super, which favors preserving general capabilities (§ 5.3 ). Appendix B lists the full settings.

paragraphs.en: The success of midtraining is ultimately measured by how well the model does after post-training. Our evaluation protocol is therefore holistic. It runs the full post-training pipeline and also tracks base-model post-trainability metrics and pretraining general-capability benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 中期训练的成功最终取决于模型在后续训练后的表现。 因此，我们的评估方案是全面的。 该方案会运行完整的后续训练流程，同时跟踪基础模型的后续训练能力指标以及预训练通用能力基准。

paragraphs.en: Short and full SFT. We use an agentic-focused SFT blend (Appendix B.1 ) at two budgets, 33B tokens (short SFT) and 100B tokens (full SFT), and compare each midtrained model with its starting checkpoint after identical SFT. Full SFT was close to saturation in our runs and supports the main claims, while short SFT gives a quicker signal.
paragraphs.zh: 简短与完整 SFT。 我们在两种预算下使用以智能体为中心的混合 SFT（附录 B.1）：330 亿个标记（简短 SFT）和 1000 亿个标记（完整 SFT），并在相同的 SFT 训练后，将每个中期训练模型与其初始检查点进行比较。 在我们的实验中，完整 SFT 接近饱和状态，并支持主要论点，而简短 SFT 则能更快地提供信号。

paragraphs.en: Base-model post-trainability metrics. LoCoDiff ( Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ) , RepoBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and bits-per-byte on held-out code repositories and on agent traces (Appendix C.2 ) measure capabilities that midtraining targets, such as file-state tracking and cross-file modeling. For traces we score the decisive turns of DeepSWE trajectories ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , which correlated best with post-training results. LoCoDiff is averaged over 3 greedy runs on all 198 cases, and the other metrics are single runs. They improve with midtraining (Table 5 ), but did not track post-training results closely enough to guide recipe decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型训练后能力指标。 LoCoDiff（Mentat AI Team（2025），AbanteAI）、RepoBench（Liu 等，2024）以及基于预留代码库和智能体轨迹的 bits-per-byte 指标（附录 C.2），用于衡量中期训练目标所对应的能力，例如文件状态跟踪和跨文件建模。 对于轨迹数据，我们对 DeepSWE 轨迹中的关键决策节点进行评分（Yu 等，2026），这些节点与训练后结果的相关性最强。 LoCoDiff 是在全部 198 个案例上通过 3 次贪心运行取平均的结果，而其他指标则仅基于单次运行。 这些指标在中期训练阶段有所提升（表 5），但未能足够紧密地跟踪训练后结果，因此无法有效指导训练方案决策。

paragraphs.en: Our first experiment midtrains the N-3.5 Lightning-8K base model for 100B tokens, once on the full blend and once without agentic traces, and compares both with the base model after identical SFT (Table 2 ). Gains seen after short SFT carry over to full SFT, so short SFT can serve as a quick check. Midtraining improves SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual pass@1 by 0.8 and 8.2 points after short SFT, and both gains remain after full SFT (3.8 and 3.7 points). Terminal-Bench is noisier and improves only in full-SFT pass@1. Agentic traces give the majority of the gain after SFT. The no-traces model, trained on natural data alone, gains less than one point on SWE-bench Verified after full SFT, while the full blend improves on it by 3.0, 2.5, and 6.6 points on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Terminal-Bench. We still keep natural data as the large majority of the blend. Its benefits show up beyond SWE-bench pass@1, in file-state tracking and cross-file modeling (Tables 5 and 5 ) and robustness across agent harnesses (§ 4.5 ), and a blend of mostly traces would amount to a much longer SFT, which can hurt later RL trainability ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的首次实验对 N-3.5 Lightning-8K 基础模型进行了中期训练，训练数据量为 100B tokens，分别使用完整混合数据和不含智能体痕迹的数据进行训练，并将两者与经过相同 SFT 后的基础模型进行比较（表 2）。 短期 SFT 后观察到的提升会延续到完整 SFT 中，因此短期 SFT 可以作为一种快速检验方法。 在短期 SFT 之后，中期训练使 SWE-bench Verified 和 Multilingual 的 pass@1 分别提升了 0.8 和 8.2 分，并且在完整 SFT 后这两种提升仍然存在（分别为 3.8 分和 3.7 分）。 Terminal-Bench 的结果波动较大，且仅在完整 SFT 的 pass@1 指标上有所提升。 智能体痕迹贡献了 SFT 后大部分的提升。 仅使用自然数据训练的无痕迹模型在完整 SFT 后，SWE-bench Verified 的得分提升不到一分，而完整混合模型在该指标上的提升分别为 3.0、2.5 和 6.6 分（分别对应 SWE-bench Verified、Multilingual 和 Terminal-Bench）。 我们仍然将自然数据作为混合数据中的主要组成部分。 其优势不仅体现在 SWE-bench pass@1 上，还体现在文件状态跟踪和跨文件建模（表 5 和表 5）以及在不同智能体工具包中的稳健性（§ 4.5）；而主要由痕迹组成的混合数据将导致更长的 SFT 训练时间，这可能会损害后续的强化学习训练能力（Liu et al., 2026b; Kang et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our main N-3.5 Lightning experiment uses the long-context checkpoint N-3.5 Lightning-LC as the base model (§ 3.1 ). The blend has about 380B unique tokens (Table 1 ), enough to midtrain for 500B tokens while seeing each natural source about once. We apply identical full SFT to the base model and to midtrained checkpoints from 100B to 500B tokens (Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们主要的 N-3.5 Lightning 实验以长上下文检查点 N-3.5 Lightning-LC 作为基础模型（§ 3.1）。 该混合模型约有 3800 亿个唯一词元（表 1），足以对 5000 亿个词元进行中期训练，同时每个自然来源大约只会被看到一次。 我们对基础模型以及从 1000 亿到 5000 亿词元的中期训练检查点应用了完全相同的完整 SFT（表 3）。

paragraphs.en: Midtraining improves every benchmark over the base model. After 500B tokens, pass@1 rises by 3.8 points on SWE-bench Verified, 7.0 on SWE-bench Multilingual, 3.5 on SWE-bench Pro, and 1.0 on Terminal-Bench, and pass@ k k rises on all four, by 2.3 to 4.7 points. Most of the SWE-bench Verified and Pro gain arrives by 100B tokens, SWE-bench Multilingual keeps improving up to 500B, and Terminal-Bench is noisier and peaks at 300B. Unlike Table 2 , these results start from N-3.5 Lightning-LC. After identical full SFT, its scores differ slightly from those of N-3.5 Lightning-8K, but stay within run-to-run variation. Midtraining also changes how the agent uses its context. Without midtraining, 4.1% of SWE-bench Pro rollouts fail by filling the 256K context window, compared with 0.6% after 500B tokens (Appendix E.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 中期训练在所有基准测试上均优于基础模型。 在达到 500B 个 token 后，SWE-bench Verified 的 pass@1 提升了 3.8 分，SWE-bench Multilingual 提升了 7.0 分，SWE-bench Pro 提升了 3.5 分，Terminal-Bench 提升了 1.0 分；而 pass@k 在这四个测试中的提升幅度为 2.3 至 4.7 分。 SWE-bench Verified 和 Pro 的大部分性能提升发生在达到 100B 个 token 时，SWE-bench Multilingual 则持续改进直至 500B 个 token，而 Terminal-Bench 的表现波动较大，并在 300B 个 token 时达到峰值。 与表 2 不同，这些结果是从 N-3.5 Lightning-LC 开始的。 在完成完全相同的 SFT 训练后，其得分与 N-3.5 Lightning-8K 略有差异，但仍在单次运行间的正常波动范围内。 中期训练也改变了智能体使用上下文的方式。 在没有中期训练的情况下，4.1% 的 SWE-bench Pro 推理过程因填满 256K 的上下文窗口而失败，而在达到 500B 个 token 后，这一比例降至 0.6%（附录 E.1）。

paragraphs.en: We further apply the recipe to the larger N-3.5 Super to test how it scales with model size. We midtrain for 65B and 280B tokens with the blend in Figure 1 . As in the scaling run, we start from the long-context checkpoint and compare each midtrained model with the base model after identical short and full SFT (Table 6 ). The clearest gain is on DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , the hardest benchmark, whose long-horizon tasks are written from scratch. After full SFT, 280B tokens of midtraining raise it from 11.7 to 15.7, and after short SFT from 6.4 to 12.4. SWE-bench Verified also improves, from 72.9 to 74.3 after full SFT, and BrowseComp by 3 points after both short and full SFT. SWE-bench Multilingual and Pro do not improve. After full SFT they are 1.1 and 2.1 points below the base model, while after short SFT they are level with or slightly above it, so we do not read these differences as a consistent effect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步将该方法应用于更大的 N-3.5 Super，以测试其随模型规模变化的扩展性。 我们对 65B 和 280B 个词元进行了中间训练，并使用图 1 中的混合策略。 与扩展实验一样，我们从长上下文检查点开始，并在相同的短 SFT 和完整 SFT 之后，将每个经过中间训练的模型与基础模型进行比较（表 6）。 最明显的提升体现在 DeepSWE（Huang 等人，2026）上，这是最具挑战性的基准测试，其长时程任务均为从头编写。 在完整 SFT 之后，280B 个词元的中间训练使其得分从 11.7 提升至 15.7；而在短 SFT 之后，则从 6.4 提升至 12.4。 SWE-bench Verified 的表现也有所提升：完整 SFT 后从 72.9 升至 74.3，而 BrowseComp 在短 SFT 和完整 SFT 后均提升了 3 分。 SWE-bench Multilingual 和 Pro 并未出现性能提升。 在完整 SFT 之后，它们分别比基础模型低 1.1 分和 2.1 分；而在短 SFT 之后，其表现则与基础模型相当或略高于后者，因此我们并不将这些差异视为一种稳定的效应。

sents.zh: 我们进一步将该方法应用于更大的 N-3.5 Super，以测试其随模型规模变化的扩展性。

sents.en: We midtrain for 65B and 280B tokens with the blend in Figure 1 .
sents.zh: 我们对 65B 和 280B 个词元进行了中间训练，并使用图 1 中的混合策略。

sents.en: As in the scaling run, we start from the long-context checkpoint and compare each midtrained model with the base model after identical short and full SFT (Table 6 ).
sents.zh: 与扩展实验一样，我们从长上下文检查点开始，并在相同的短 SFT 和完整 SFT 之后，将每个经过中间训练的模型与基础模型进行比较（表 6）。

sents.en: The clearest gain is on DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , the hardest benchmark, whose long-horizon tasks are written from scratch.
sents.zh: 最明显的提升体现在 DeepSWE（Huang 等人，2026）上，这是最具挑战性的基准测试，其长时程任务均为从头编写。

sents.en: After full SFT, 280B tokens of midtraining raise it from 11.7 to 15.7, and after short SFT from 6.4 to 12.4.
sents.zh: 在完整 SFT 之后，280B 个词元的中间训练使其得分从 11.7 提升至 15.7；而在短 SFT 之后，则从 6.4 提升至 12.4。

sents.en: SWE-bench Verified also improves, from 72.9 to 74.3 after full SFT, and BrowseComp by 3 points after both short and full SFT.
sents.zh: SWE-bench Verified 的表现也有所提升：完整 SFT 后从 72.9 升至 74.3，而 BrowseComp 在短 SFT 和完整 SFT 后均提升了 3 分。

sents.en: SWE-bench Multilingual and Pro do not improve.
sents.zh: SWE-bench Multilingual 和 Pro 并未出现性能提升。

sents.en: After full SFT they are 1.1 and 2.1 points below the base model, while after short SFT they are level with or slightly above it, so we do not read these differences as a consistent effect.
sents.zh: 在完整 SFT 之后，它们分别比基础模型低 1.1 分和 2.1 分；而在短 SFT 之后，其表现则与基础模型相当或略高于后者，因此我们并不将这些差异视为一种稳定的效应。

paragraphs.en: Open models are used with many agent harnesses, not only the one their SFT data was built for, so harness robustness is a goal of our midtraining and the reason we draw traces from many scaffolds. Table 7 shows that midtraining improves pass@1 on every harness we tested, which makes both models more robust to the choice of harness, although large differences between harnesses remain. On N-3.5 Super after short SFT, the midtrained model is better on every harness, by 8.6 points on average on SWE-bench Verified and 6.8 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On N-3.5 Lightning-8K after full SFT, midtraining improves SWE-bench Verified on all six harnesses, by 11.6 points on average. Midtraining on the natural data alone already improves over the base model on four of the six harnesses, by up to 4.7 points, and adding the traces gives the largest gains. We did not train on traces from a single scaffold, so these results do not separate the effect of scaffold diversity from that of adding traces.
paragraphs.zh: 开放模型会与多种智能体框架配合使用，而不仅仅是其 SFT 数据所针对的特定框架，因此框架的稳健性是我们中期训练的目标，也是我们从多个架构中提取轨迹的原因。 表 7 显示，中期训练提升了我们所测试的每个框架的 pass@1 指标，这使得两个模型对框架选择都更具稳健性，尽管不同框架之间的显著差异仍然存在。 在 N-3.5 Super 经过短期 SFT 后，经过中期训练的模型在每个框架上的表现均更优，在 SWE-bench Verified 上平均提升 8.6 分，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上平均提升 6.8 分。 在 N-3.5 Lightning-8K 经过完整 SFT 后，中期训练在所有六个框架上提升了 SWE-bench Verified 的表现，平均提升 11.6 分。 仅对自然数据进行中期训练，就已经在六个框架中的四个上优于基础模型，提升幅度最高可达 4.7 分，而加入轨迹则带来了最大的增益。 我们没有使用单一架构的轨迹进行训练，因此这些结果无法区分架构多样性的影响与添加轨迹所带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: Because midtraining trains at 256K, it also extends the model’s context. Table 8 compares the usual order, where N-3.5 Lightning-8K goes straight to the long-context stage, with a 100B-token N-3.5 Lightning midtraining run at 256K before a long-context stage. Midtraining alone brings N-3.5 Lightning-8K within about five points of the long-context base model on RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) up to 128K, but trails by 14 points at 256K. After the long-context stage, the midtrained model beats the long-context base model at every length from 64K to 256K and stays within two points at shorter lengths. Midtraining thus does part of the work of the long-context stage, and this carries over to the final model. Appendix E.2 gives more results for N-3.5 Super.
paragraphs.zh: 由于中期训练是在 256K 下进行的，因此它也会扩展模型的上下文长度。 表 8 对比了通常的顺序（其中 N-3.5 Lightning-8K 直接进入长上下文阶段）与另一种顺序：在长上下文阶段之前，先对 N-3.5 Lightning 进行 100B 个 token、以 256K 为规模的中期训练。 仅通过中期训练，N-3.5 Lightning-8K 在 RULER（Hsieh et al., 2024）测试中，上下文长度达到 128K 时与长上下文基础模型的差距缩小到约 5 分，但在 256K 时仍落后 14 分。 经过长上下文阶段后，中期训练模型在 64K 到 256K 的所有上下文长度上均优于长上下文基础模型，并且在较短的长度上也仅落后 2 分以内。 因此，中期训练完成了长上下文阶段的部分工作，并且这种效果会延续到最终模型中。 附录 E.2 提供了 N-3.5 Super 的更多结果。

paragraphs.en: Agent traces interleave the model’s own actions with tool responses, the outputs the environment returns after each tool call. Some recent work also trains on tool responses, so that the model learns to predict how the environment reacts, a form of world modeling ( FAIR CodeGen Team, 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体轨迹将模型自身的动作与工具响应交织在一起，即环境在每次工具调用后返回的输出。 一些近期的研究也对工具响应进行训练，使模型学会预测环境的反应，这是一种世界建模的形式（FAIR CodeGen Team, 2025；Zeng et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: We tested this with the setup of § 4.2 , midtraining N-3.5 Lightning-8K for 100B tokens with and without tool responses in the loss, followed by identical SFT with an earlier version of our SFT recipe. In our experiments, training on tool responses did not work out of the box and lowered SWE-bench Verified pass@1 by about 10 points (Table 9 ), so we train only on assistant turns, as in SFT. Tool responses are often long and noisy, such as file dumps, test logs, and error traces, and predicting them may take capacity away from learning the agent’s own actions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 § 4.2 中的设置对此进行了测试：在训练中期对 N-3.5 Lightning-8K 模型进行 100B 个标记的训练，并在损失函数中分别包含和不包含工具响应，随后采用与我们早期 SFT 方案相同的 SFT 方法。 在我们的实验中，直接对工具响应进行训练并未取得预期效果，反而使 SWE-bench 的 Verified pass@1 指标下降了约 10 个百分点（见表 9），因此我们仅对助手回合进行训练，与 SFT 的做法一致。 工具响应通常较长且包含大量噪声，例如文件内容、测试日志和错误追踪等，预测这些响应可能会占用智能体学习自身行动所需的模型容量。

paragraphs.en: Replay keeps the model close to its pretraining distribution, so that midtraining shifts the data distribution gradually rather than abruptly. We started from 20% replay as a reasonable default, with the goal of no regression on general-capability benchmarks. Table 11 shows that N-3.5 Super does not regress through 65B tokens, with every benchmark group within 1.2 points of the starting checkpoint. We also tried 40% replay, which gave no clear benefit over 20%, so we kept 20%.
paragraphs.zh: 重播使模型保持接近其预训练分布，从而在训练中逐步而非突然地改变数据分布。 我们从 20% 的重播作为合理的默认值开始，目标是确保通用能力基准测试不会出现性能下降。 表 11 显示，N-3.5 Super 在处理 65B 个 token 时没有出现性能下降，所有基准测试组的结果与初始检查点相比都在 1.2 分以内。 我们还尝试了 40% 的重播，但并未比 20% 带来明显优势，因此我们保留了 20% 的设置。

sents.zh: 重播使模型保持接近其预训练分布，从而在训练中逐步而非突然地改变数据分布。

paragraphs.en: The learning rate also affects general capabilities. Pretraining ends with a small, decayed learning rate, and midtraining needs a higher one to learn the new data. In our early runs, midtraining at 1e-5 gave smaller gains after SFT than higher rates did. Raising the rate too far, however, hurts general capabilities even with replay. Table 11 compares a constant 1e-5 with warming up to 3e-5 or 5e-5. Both higher rates lower general capabilities, most clearly MATH-500, which falls from 79.7 to 61.7 at 5e-5. We therefore recommend a moderate increase and checking general-capability benchmarks while tuning it.
paragraphs.zh: 学习率也会影响通用能力。 预训练以较小的衰减学习率结束，而中期训练则需要较高的学习率来学习新数据。 在我们早期的运行中，在中期训练时使用 1e-5 的学习率，其 SFT 后的提升效果不如更高学习率显著。 然而，将学习率调得过高，即使有重播机制，也会损害通用能力。 表 11 比较了固定使用 1e-5 与逐步提升至 3e-5 或 5e-5 的情况。 两种较高的学习率都会降低通用能力，其中 MATH-500 的下降最为明显：在 5e-5 时，其得分从 79.7 降至 61.7。 因此，我们建议在调整学习率时适度提高，并同步检查通用能力基准测试的表现。

paragraphs.en: We presented an open midtraining recipe for agentic coding, with full details of how each data source is built, filtered, and weighted and how the models are trained. After identical SFT, the recipe gives clear gains as midtraining scales to 500B tokens on N-3.5 Lightning, and it carries over to the larger N-3.5 Super, where it raises DeepSWE, the hardest benchmark we evaluate, from 11.7 to 15.7 and also improves SWE-bench Verified and BrowseComp. On both models, midtraining improves results on every agent harness we tested. Our experiments show that agentic traces are essential, since natural software-engineering data alone gives much smaller gains after SFT, and that a short SFT run gives a more direct post-training signal than base-model post-trainability metrics, which remain useful to track. Midtraining at 256K also works as an intermediate long-context stage, and we explain our other modeling choices, such as tool-response masking and pretraining replay.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种用于智能体编程的开放中期训练方案，详细说明了每个数据源如何构建、筛选和加权，以及模型如何训练。 在相同的 SFT 之后，该方案在 N-3.5 Lightning 上将中期训练规模扩大至 500B 词元时带来了显著提升，并且这种优势也延续到了更大的 N-3.5 Super 模型上：它将我们评估的最难基准 DeepSWE 的得分从 11.7 提升至 15.7，同时改进了 SWE-bench Verified 和 BrowseComp 的表现。 在这两个模型上，中期训练都提升了我们在所有测试过的智能体框架上的结果。 我们的实验表明，智能体轨迹至关重要，因为仅靠自然软件工程数据在 SFT 之后带来的提升要小得多；此外，较短的 SFT 运行比基础模型的训练后能力指标能提供更直接的训练后信号，而这些指标仍然值得持续追踪。 在 256K 规模上的中期训练也可以作为中间长上下文阶段使用，我们还解释了其他建模选择，例如工具响应掩码和预训练重播。

sents.en: We presented an open midtraining recipe for agentic coding, with full details of how each data source is built, filtered, and weighted and how the models are trained.

sents.zh: 在这两个模型上，中期训练都提升了我们在所有测试过的智能体框架上的结果。

sents.en: Our experiments show that agentic traces are essential, since natural software-engineering data alone gives much smaller gains after SFT, and that a short SFT run gives a more direct post-training signal than base-model post-trainability metrics, which remain useful to track.

sents.en: Midtraining at 256K also works as an intermediate long-context stage, and we explain our other modeling choices, such as tool-response masking and pretraining replay.
sents.zh: 在 256K 规模上的中期训练也可以作为中间长上下文阶段使用，我们还解释了其他建模选择，例如工具响应掩码和预训练重播。

paragraphs.en: Agentic benchmarks are noisy, and each comparison is a single run, so differences of one or two points, especially on Terminal-Bench, may come from run-to-run variation. We did not compare against spending the same tokens on longer pretraining or SFT, since midtraining adds a separate stage that complements SFT rather than replacing it. We tested the recipe only on Nemotron models, not on other model families, and mainly on agentic coding. Our SFT evaluations use an agentic-focused SFT blend rather than a full general-purpose post-training blend. Our RL results are also limited, since clear RL gains on top of a strong SFT checkpoint were difficult to get at the N-3.5 Lightning scale and RL was too compute intensive at the N-3.5 Super scale, so we report only a short, single-seed run on N-3.5 Lightning-8K (Appendix D ). For future work, since traces drove most of the gains, we plan to scale trace data with more diversity, and we have already expanded our trace corpus to about 90B tokens. We also plan to extend the agentic data to more capabilities and to move more post-training data, such as reasoning and chat data, into midtraining.

paragraphs.en: For PRs linked to an issue, an LLM judge checks whether the issue and the PR match. The judge reads the full issue and PR text, the final patch, and the paths of the changed files, and labels each pair as clean or assigns one of seven failure modes, namely a revert, an incidental issue link, a wrong issue reference, a partial fix, an issue with no clear action, an underspecified issue, or a PR that does much more than the issue asks. We keep clean pairs and remove pairs that cannot be fixed. We repair the others by linking the PR to the correct issue, narrowing its scope, keeping it as a PR-only example, or splitting it from unrelated changes. For PRs without a linked issue, we remove those that change only README files or three lines or fewer.
paragraphs.zh: 对于与某个问题关联的拉取请求，大型语言模型裁判会检查该问题与拉取请求是否匹配。 裁判会阅读完整的问题和拉取请求文本、最终补丁以及已更改文件的路径，然后将每对组合标记为“干净”，或分配七种失败模式之一：回滚、附带的问题关联、错误的问题引用、部分修复、问题没有明确操作、问题描述不够具体，或者拉取请求超出了问题所要求的内容。 我们保留“干净”的组合，并移除无法修复的组合。 我们通过将拉取请求关联到正确的问题、缩小其范围、将其作为仅包含拉取请求的示例保留，或将其与无关的更改拆分开来，从而修复其余的组合。 对于没有关联问题的拉取请求，我们会移除那些仅更改 README 文件或更改三行或更少内容的拉取请求。

paragraphs.en: The repository data starts from the code repositories in the Nemotron 3 pretraining corpus ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) , a deduplicated collection of public repositories with permissive licenses, and covers 14 languages (Table 12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该仓库数据始于 Nemotron 3 预训练语料库中的代码仓库（NVIDIA，2025），这是一个由采用宽松许可协议的公共仓库组成的去重集合，涵盖了 14 种语言（表 12）。

paragraphs.en: For each language, we parse the references that link one file to another, such as imports in Python, includes in C and C++, and module paths in Go. A repository’s connected fraction is the share of its code files that import another file in the repository, and we keep repositories where this share is at least 20%. For Ruby we lower the threshold to 10%, because Rails autoloading hides most references from static parsing. We exclude languages with little cross-file structure that parsing can recover, such as Shell, R, and Swift, as well as markup and configuration languages.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每种语言，我们都会解析将某个文件链接到另一个文件的引用，例如 Python 中的导入、C 和 C++ 中的包含，以及 Go 中的模块路径。 仓库的连通比例是指其代码文件中导入该仓库内其他文件的文件所占的比例，我们只保留该比例至少为 20% 的仓库。 对于 Ruby，我们将阈值降至 10%，因为 Rails 的自动加载机制会隐藏大多数静态解析无法检测到的引用。 我们排除那些通过解析难以恢复跨文件结构的语言，例如 Shell、R 和 Swift，以及标记语言和配置语言。

paragraphs.en: The code files follow the README in depth-first order over the import graph, so the files of each connected component stay together and each file sits near the files it imports. Each file starts with a header that gives the repository name and file path, and the header is masked from the loss.
paragraphs.zh: 代码文件按照导入图以深度优先顺序遵循 README，因此每个连通分量的文件都保持在一起，且每个文件都位于其导入的文件附近。 每个文件都以一个包含仓库名称和文件路径的标题开头，并且该标题会从损失函数中屏蔽掉。

sents.zh: 每个文件都以一个包含仓库名称和文件路径的标题开头，并且该标题会从损失函数中屏蔽掉。

paragraphs.en: We deduplicate files by path within each repository and drop Python 2 code, removing the whole repository when most of it is Python 2. We drop repositories that contain server-side secrets, such as cloud or API keys, and redact client-side keys, which are common in mobile and web projects. We also strip license and auto-generated headers, and drop repositories above 2M tokens or those that lose most of their files in deduplication. To avoid contamination, we remove SWE-bench repositories and their forks, as well as files that contain HumanEval, MBPP, or LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个仓库中的文件按路径进行去重，并删除 Python 2 代码；如果某个仓库的大部分代码都是 Python 2，则直接删除整个仓库。 我们会删除包含服务器端机密信息（如云密钥或 API 密钥）的仓库，并对客户端密钥进行脱敏处理——这类密钥在移动和网页项目中很常见。 我们还会移除许可证和自动生成的页眉，并删除令牌数超过 200 万个，或在去重过程中丢失大部分文件的仓库。 为避免数据污染，我们会移除 SWE-bench 仓库及其分支，以及包含 HumanEval、MBPP 或 LiveCodeBench（Jain 等人，2025）解决方案的文件。

paragraphs.en: We start from each language’s natural token share, upweight Python, and downweight Dart, Scala, and Lua (Table 12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从每种语言的天然词元占比出发，提升 Python 的权重，同时降低 Dart、Scala 和 Lua 的权重（表 12）。

paragraphs.en: Multi-file edits come from merged pull requests in the Issue–PR corpus, with the full patch and every changed file before the change. Code-evolution documents come from the full git histories of 6,550 permissively licensed repositories from the same corpus, chosen to match the language mix of SWE-bench Multilingual. We keep only patches that apply exactly and histories that replay byte for byte. In multi-file edits, the loss covers the original files, the diffs, and the changed lines of the new files with two lines of context. In code-evolution documents, it covers the commit messages, diffs, and final state, and license blocks are masked in both. We remove all repositories used in SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Pro, Multi-SWE-bench ( Zan et al., 2025 ) , Terminal-Bench, and LoCoDiff, deduplicate examples, and drop GPL-licensed documents, secrets, lockfiles, and generated files. Histories have a median of 3 commits and up to 59, and the median document is about 6K tokens (Table 13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 多文件编辑来自 Issue–PR 语料库中已合并的拉取请求，其中包含完整的补丁以及变更前的所有修改文件。 代码演化文档来自同一语料库中 6,550 个采用宽松许可协议的仓库的完整 Git 历史记录，这些仓库的选择旨在匹配 SWE-bench Multilingual 的语言混合比例。 我们仅保留能够精确应用的补丁以及能够逐字节重放的版本历史。 在多文件编辑中，损失函数涵盖原始文件、差异片段以及新文件中带有两行上下文信息的修改行。 在代码演化文档中，损失函数涵盖提交信息、差异片段和最终状态，且两者中的许可声明部分均被遮蔽处理。 我们移除了 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Pro、Multi-SWE-bench（Zan 等人，2025）、Terminal-Bench 和 LoCoDiff 中使用的所有仓库，去除了重复示例，并排除了采用 GPL 许可的文档、秘密信息、锁文件以及生成文件。 版本历史的提交次数中位数为 3 次，最多可达 59 次；文档的中位数长度约为 6K 个词元（表 13）。

sents.en: Multi-file edits come from merged pull requests in the Issue–PR corpus, with the full patch and every changed file before the change.

paragraphs.en: Raw logs come from the full LogHub archives (BGL, Thunderbird, HPC, HDFS, Spark, and Windows). We cut them into non-overlapping windows of 120 context lines followed by 16 target lines. We deduplicate HDFS logs after masking block identifiers, hosts, and timestamps. No single archive is more than 28% of this source. Supercomputer logs are at least 30%, and CI/CD logs from GHALogs run logs and workflow-file histories are at least 12%. We check every source against a license registry and exclude sources with unknown licenses. We also build 632 diagnosis examples. Each centers a window of HPC logs on a warning, error, or critical event, and a frontier model writes the diagnosis from the window and from findings that simple rules extract. We redact secrets and mask timestamps, hostnames, hashes, and repeated boilerplate from the loss.
paragraphs.zh: 原始日志来自完整的 LogHub 存档（BGL、Thunderbird、HPC、HDFS、Spark 和 Windows）。 我们将这些日志切割为互不重叠的窗口，每个窗口包含 120 行上下文和随后的 16 行目标内容。 在掩码块标识符、主机和timestamps后，我们对 HDFS 日志进行去重处理。 没有任何单个存档占此数据源的比例超过 28%。 超级计算机日志至少占 30%，而来自 GHALogs 运行日志和流程文件历史的 CI/CD 日志至少占 12%。 我们将每个数据源与许可证注册表进行核对，并排除许可证不明的数据源。 我们还构建了 632 个诊断示例。 每个示例都以 HPC 日志中的警告、错误或严重事件为中心构建一个窗口，并由一个前沿模型根据该窗口内容以及简单规则提取出的发现信息撰写诊断结果。 我们从损失函数中删除了敏感信息，并对 timestamps、主机名、哈希值以及重复的模板文本进行了掩码处理。

paragraphs.en: For all agentic benchmarks, we sample with temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95. SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) Verified ( Chowdhury et al., 2024 ) (500 tasks), SWE-bench Multilingual ( Yang et al., 2025 ) (300), and SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2026 ) (731) use the OpenHands agent ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) (SDK version 1.17.0) with 3 rollouts per task. Each rollout has at most 200 turns, or 250 for SWE-bench Pro. Terminal-Bench 2.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) (89 tasks) uses the Terminus-2 agent ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) with a one-hour limit per task and 8 rollouts per task. The harness sweep and the RL evaluation use Terminal-Bench 2.1, which has the same 89 tasks with 28 of them fixed, and we compare scores only within a version. DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026 ) pass@1 is averaged over 4 runs. BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) is evaluated on a subset of the benchmark in a custom agent harness, with Exa as the search provider. For N-3.5 Super, run-to-run variation is about 1 point on SWE-bench Verified and Pro and about 2 points on DeepSWE. We report pass@1 as the mean success rate over rollouts and compute pass@ k k from the same rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有智能体基准测试中，我们使用温度 1.0 和 top-p 0.95 进行采样。 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等，2024）、Verified（Chowdhury 等，2024）（500 项任务）、SWE-bench Multilingual（Yang 等，2025）（300 项任务）以及 SWE-bench Pro（Deng 等，2026）（731 项任务）均使用 OpenHands 智能体（Wang 等，2025；Wang 等，2026）（SDK 版本 1.17.0），每项任务执行 3 次运行。 每次运行最多包含 200 轮交互，SWE-bench Pro 则为 250 轮。 Terminal-Bench 2.0（Merrill 等，2026）（89 项任务）使用 Terminus-2 智能体（Merrill 等，2026），每项任务限制一小时并执行 8 次运行。 Harness sweep 和 RL 评估使用 Terminal-Bench 2.1，该版本包含相同的 89 项任务，其中 28 项为固定任务；我们仅在同一个版本内比较得分。 DeepSWE（Huang 等，2026）的 pass@1 是在 4 次运行中取平均值。 BrowseComp（Wei 等，2025）在自定义智能体框架中对基准测试的子集进行评估，并使用 Exa 作为搜索提供商。 对于 N-3.5 Super，SWE-bench Verified 和 Pro 的每次运行之间的差异约为 1 分，DeepSWE 的差异约为 2 分。 我们将 pass@1 报告为各次运行成功率的平均值，并从相同的运行中计算 pass@ k k。

paragraphs.en: LoCoDiff ( Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ) gives the model the full git history of a file and asks it to write the file’s final state. We use all 198 cases, zero-shot with greedy decoding and a 16K-token generation budget, which covers the longest reference file (11.7K tokens). Exact match is the share of files reproduced byte for byte, and normalized edit distance is capped at 1.2 per case. Greedy decoding still varies slightly across runs because inference is not bit-exact, so we average both over 3 runs.
paragraphs.zh: LoCoDiff（Mentat AI Team（2025），AbanteAI）向模型提供某个文件的完整 Git 历史记录，并要求其写出该文件的最终状态。 我们使用了全部 198 个案例，采用零样本、贪心解码以及 16K 个标记的生成预算，这一预算足以覆盖最长的参考文件（11.7K 个标记）。 完全匹配是指逐字节复现的文件比例，而归一化编辑距离在每个案例中最多为 1.2。 由于推理过程并非逐位精确，贪心解码在不同运行中仍存在细微差异，因此我们对两次运行的结果取平均值。

paragraphs.en: RepoBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) measures next-line code completion that requires context from other files in the repository. We report edit similarity in the cross-file-first setting, with greedy decoding.

paragraphs.en: As a preliminary check on whether midtraining gains persist under RL, we run an identical short stage of RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR), 20 GRPO steps ( Shao et al., 2024 ) over 14 verifiable environments (Appendix D.2 ), from N-3.5 Lightning-8K and its midtrained checkpoint after full SFT. Twenty steps is too short to measure an RL gain, so we only ask whether the midtrained model’s advantage survives the start of RL.
paragraphs.zh: 为了初步检验中期训练的成果在强化学习（RL）中是否持续存在，我们运行了一个完全相同的短阶段强化学习验证任务（RLVR），使用可验证的奖励机制，执行了 20 个 GRPO 步骤（Shao et al., 2024），覆盖了 14 个可验证的环境（附录 D.2），实验基于 N-3.5 Lightning-8K 模型及其在完成全部监督微调（SFT）后的中期训练检查点。 20 步对于衡量强化学习的提升效果而言过于短暂，因此我们仅关注中期训练模型的优势是否在强化学习开始阶段得以保留。

paragraphs.en: The midtrained model starts about two points ahead on SWE-bench Verified pass@1 and keeps that lead at every RL step, and both models stay close to their SFT scores (Table 18 ). On Terminal-Bench 2.1, the base model’s pass@8 falls from 46.1 to 39.3 over 20 steps while the midtrained model’s holds at 45 to 46, although with 89 tasks this drop amounts to only six tasks. Training-time signals, including mean reward, generation length, and format violations, also favor the midtrained model (Appendix D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 中期训练模型在 SWE-bench Verified pass@1 上的起始分数领先约两个百分点，并在每一步强化学习过程中都保持这一优势；同时，两种模型的得分都与其 SFT 分数保持接近（表 18）。 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，基础模型的 pass@8 在 20 步内从 46.1 下降至 39.3，而中期训练模型则维持在 45 到 46 之间；尽管有 89 个任务，这一差距仅相当于六个任务。 训练过程中的信号指标，包括平均奖励、生成长度和格式违规情况，也显示出中期训练模型更具优势（附录 D.2）。

paragraphs.en: With a single seed and 20 steps, these results do not show that midtraining increases what RL can add, only that the midtrained model’s advantage after SFT is not lost when RL begins.

paragraphs.en: The RLVR prompt blend is drawn from 14 verifiable environments (tool use, code generation, SWE and search pivots, instruction following, reasoning, and formatting). We reward-profile a seed blend against both checkpoints and keep only prompts with mixed rewards, meaning that for each checkpoint some but not all of its sampled rollouts succeed, so every prompt is neither trivial nor unsolvable for either model. Training is GRPO with a leave-one-out baseline and no reference-policy KL penalty, 256 prompts × \times 16 generations per step, a 32K-token output cap within a 131K context, a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} with 10 warmup steps, and 20 optimizer updates. The two runs differ only in their starting checkpoint; they use the same blend, seed, and prompt order. We evaluate SWE-bench Verified with 5 rollouts per task and Terminal-Bench 2.1 with 8, for both the SFT starting points and the RL checkpoints.

paragraphs.en: Training-time metrics, averaged over matched steps, favor the midtrained model. It earns 4.3% higher train reward (0.308 vs. 0.295) with 12% shorter generations (4.6K vs. 5.3K mean tokens), and it produces format violations (a stray end-of-sequence token or malformed thinking tags, which zero the reward) about ten times less often (0.03% vs. 0.34% of trajectories). Its truncation rate is also lower (0.056% vs. 0.073%). Together these make RL from the midtrained checkpoint about 15% faster per trajectory on the same hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 训练阶段指标（在匹配步骤上取平均）显示，中期训练模型更具优势。 该模型获得的训练奖励高出 4.3%（0.308 对比 0.295），生成过程缩短 12%（平均 4.6K 对比 5.3K 个词元），且格式违规（如多余的序列结束词元或格式错误的思考标签，这些会导致奖励归零）的发生频率低约十倍（轨迹中 0.03% 对比 0.34%）。 其截断率也更低（0.056% 对比 0.073%）。 综合来看，这些因素使得使用中期训练检查点进行的强化学习，在相同硬件上每条轨迹的处理速度提升约 15%。

paragraphs.en: Rollouts that fill the 256K context window count as failures. Under the same harness and settings, they are much more common without midtraining (Table 19 ), especially on SWE-bench Pro. On SWE-bench Verified, rollouts also hit the 200-turn cap 11 times without midtraining and once after 500B tokens. Midtraining appears to make the agent more economical with its context and turns, not only more accurate.
paragraphs.zh: 填满 256K 上下文窗口的展开会被视为失败。 在相同的测试框架和设置下，没有中期训练时这种情况要常见得多（表 19），尤其是在 SWE-bench Pro 上。 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，没有中期训练时，展开也触发了 200 轮次上限 11 次，而在完成 500B 个词元后则触发了一次。 中期训练似乎使智能体在使用上下文和轮次时更加经济，而不仅仅是更准确。

paragraphs.en: To keep evaluation simple, our N-3.5 Super runs start midtraining from the 1M long-context checkpoint (§ 3.1 ). Midtraining then trains at 256K, so RULER at 1M naturally drops, from 79.9 to 33.0 after 25B tokens. A short long-context stage of about 9B tokens, on long-context data only, brings it back to 81.0, above the starting checkpoint, and the 65B N-3.5 Super checkpoint evaluated in § 4.4 includes this short stage, while the 280B checkpoint goes straight to SFT. This drop is a side effect of our evaluation setup. In a mature pipeline, midtraining would come before the final long-context stage, as in § 5.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为保持评估的简洁性，我们的 N-3.5 Super 训练从中期开始，使用 1M 长上下文检查点（§ 3.1）。 中期训练随后以 256K 进行，因此 RULER 在 1M 上的得分自然下降，在 25B 个 token 后从 79.9 降至 33.0。 一个仅使用长上下文数据的约 9B 个 token 的短期长上下文阶段，使其得分回升至 81.0，高于初始检查点；而 § 4.4 中评估的 65B N-3.5 Super 检查点包含了这一短期阶段，相比之下，280B 检查点则直接进入 SFT。 这种下降是我们评估设置的一个副作用。 在成熟的流程中，中期训练应早于最终的长上下文阶段，如 § 5.1 所示。
